description: This file provides functions for resolving Telegram conversation routes and base session keys within a chatbot or agent framework. It integrates with configuration, routing, and session binding services, and manages both direct and group chat scenarios, including topic agent IDs and session bindings.

methods.name: resolveTelegramConversationRoute
methods.description: Computes the routing information for a Telegram conversation based on provided parameters such as chat ID, account ID, and whether it's a group or direct message. Handles topic agent IDs and session bindings, and returns route details along with binding resolution info.

methods.name: resolveTelegramConversationBaseSessionKey
methods.description: Generates a base session key for a Telegram conversation, with special handling for fallback scenarios based on account ID and route matching method.
